description: Powder bulk density relative to water: grains of powder that fill the volume of one grain of water.

lee-vmd.name: Lee Precision Volume Measure Density (VMD) chart 90058-2
lee-vmd.methodNote: Volume of one grain of powder thrown through a Lee volume measure; loosest fill.

vihtavuori-2018.name: Vihtavuori Industrial Powders brochure 2018 (technical table)
vihtavuori-2018.methodNote: Manufacturer bulk density; method not stated (typically poured/settled per standard test).

ammoreference.name: Ammunition Reference Database, Propellant Reference
ammoreference.methodNote: Compiled bulk densities; column is labelled g/cm3 but values are printed in g/L (e.g. 920); stored as printed in g/L. Method not stated.
